name: Spear
overview: Scripture presents the spear as a significant weapon in Israel's history, both symbolically and practically. It was used in battle, as seen when Joshua stretched out his spear by God's command to claim victory (Joshua 8:18), and was notably absent among Israelite soldiers in times of distress, highlighting their lack of armament compared to their enemies (Judges 5:8; 1 Samuel 13:19, 22). The spear's formidable nature is underscored by the description of Goliath's heavy iron spearhead, emphasizing its power and intimidation (1 Samuel 17:7). Additionally, the spear served in acts of zeal, such as Phinehas taking a javelin to uphold God's justice (Numbers 25:7).
